title: Two Sum
prompt: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`.
constraints: Each input has exactly one solution.
You may not use the same element twice.
You can return the answer in any order.
hints: Brute force checks every pair — can you avoid the nested loop?
Consider a hash map from value seen so far to its index.
For each number, check if `target - num` is already in the map before inserting the current number.
